requirements.name: 1 validity
requirements.detail: solids 1, shells 1, closed True, valid True, strict True, faces 4

requirements.name: 1 extent
requirements.detail: projected span (Y) 800.000000 mm vs spec 800.000 (diff -7.88e-11); volume 962251.543 mm3 (cap adds 98251.543; OCCT default integration gives 962251.543)

requirements.name: 2 locked outline
requirements.detail: max outermost lip deviation 6.45e-07 mm over 202 cut planes; outline-to-surface max 7.24e-11 mm

requirements.name: 3 joins G1
requirements.detail: 4 edges, 1596 samples: gap 0.00e+00 mm, angle 2.20e-14 deg; curvature mismatch 3.331e-16 /mm (cross-join normal curvature 3.331e-18 /mm); closest sample to an edge end 0.00022 mm, 96 samples near collapsed corners not judged

requirements.name: 4 section rule
requirements.detail: 48 cuts (0 failed to trace); thick zone min radius 0.168801 mm at x/c 1.69371e-05 (4 of 26 below 0.4); thin zone min ratio 0.1754 at x/c 0.99999994, t 0.05 mm (22 of 22 below 0.9); 26 of the failing cuts cross the lip more than 60 deg from square; bending reversals 0 on 0 cuts

requirements.name: 4b lip-normal radius (informational)
requirements.detail: radius across the lip, perpendicular to the locked outline, at each cut's lip point; thick zone min 1.074 mm at x/c 0.9 (0 below 0.4); thin zone min ratio 12.65 at x/c 0.99978374 (0 below 0.9)

requirements.name: 5 whole-cap map
requirements.detail: worst point radius 0.904561 mm at x/c 0.998998, t 1.355 mm, margin 0.5046 mm; tightest 0.904561 mm at x/c 0.998998; points within 0.05 mm of collapsed corners not judged (grid reaches 0.0054 mm; worst there 7.99 mm, score 263)

requirements.name: 6 TE closure
requirements.detail: sharp point; right (+Y): closes True, 0.02 mm before TE: t 0.732, section min R 0.06641, ratio 0.1815; principal R within 0.1 mm of the TE point min 4.563; left (-Y): closes True, 0.02 mm before TE: t 0.732, section min R 0.06641, ratio 0.1815; principal R within 0.1 mm of the TE point min 4.563
